{{Youmay|the time-keeping device|the periodical called [[Chrono (periodical)/Legends|Chrono]]}}
[[File:Chronometers-WF.png|thumb|right|250px|Chronometers being synchronized]]
{{Quote|We'll monitor your progress on these chronometers. Synchronize on my mark. 3&hellip;2&hellip;1&hellip;mark.|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]|audio=Chronometers-WF.flac|<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>}}
A '''chronometer''', or '''chrono''' for short (also referred to as a '''clock'''), was a device that measured and kept linear time. They could be found included in most electrical devices, or stand alone versions on walls or desktops and inside [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or vehicles. In ancient times, they existed in the form of [[pendulum clock]]s.

Many beings would also carry personal versions for both practical and fashionable reasons: often wrist-worn, these were sometimes described as [[watch]]es.

Chronos were also frequently integrated into [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems, [[Computer/Legends|computer]] consoles, and even some weapons.

Chronos could often be set to follow more than one time standard. Military chronos worn by soldiers and officers were often tuned to local time, ships' time (in the case of naval officers and starship crewers) and [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|Galactic Standard Time]], which was based on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] day and hour.

Chronos were a popular target for low-level criminals trying to earn some easy credits. Chronos could be sold at pawn shops for around 60-1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] depending on the quality of it.

In his youth [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was known for telling several jokes involving a broken chronometer.
